title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today’s biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Jackson Suber leads RBC Canadian Open
items.text: Jackson Suber leads the 2026 RBC Canadian Open with a score of 13-under (197) after a shooting a 66 at TPC Toronto’s North Course on Saturday.

items.headline: Brooks Koepka injury scare
items.text: Brooks Koepka faces an injury scare at RBC Canadian Open. He said I’m struggling to grip the club with my ring finger and pinky finger. So I can’t grip it. My fingers would come loose. It was kind of numb. He withdrew this morning

items.headline: Alex Fitzpatrick on Tour pressures
items.text: Alex Fitzpatrick reflected on the pressure felt after instantly earning his PGA Tour card but is now confident following strong finishes including a Zurich Classic win and top-10s in Miami and the Memorial. He's currently T42 at the RBC Canadian Open
